title: potentilla lactea
intro: Potentilla lactea, commonly known as Chinese or Himalayan cinquefoil, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) native to the mountainous regions of Asia. The health benefits of Potentilla lactea include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Therapeutically, it has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla lactea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
